saw_lines: Shoppers buying comfort pants judge stretch, fabric and fit in seconds, then decide whether the pair deserves a second look.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where stretch and fit must land before the scroll.
Your site shows 45,000+ 5 Star Reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put 45,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: The site shows 45,000+ 5 Star Reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get claims with nothing behind them. Put 45,000+ on the creative and in line one. Open two ads with a review quote.

6 of 15 copy ads open on “with natural fibers for breathability”, so one pitch repeats across the account. Name two or three new angles from your product, such as the no track pants swap, and run each against it.
One exact copy runs in 6 of 15 ads, so a shopper who sees one sees it again and tunes out. Keep the body copy, change the opening line and the creative in each. Shoot a fresh photo for each version.
The site promotes free shipping on orders $99+, yet 0 of 15 ads lead with it, so a first time buyer has no reason to order today. Lead three new ads with free shipping over $99 and 30 day returns.

ads_1: Review and shipping openers for the No Sweat Pant, tested against breathability
